hero.title: Welcome to Price Polish
hero.line3: Stay in control of promotions and scheduled pricing.
hero.why: Price Polish helps you manage pricing changes more efficiently, reduce repetitive manual work, and maintain better control over promotions.

safety.title: Your pricing stays protected
safety.subtitle: Designed to reduce risk and help you move forward with confidence.

social.title: Built for growing Shopify merchants
social.subtitle: Designed to simplify pricing operations and reduce manual effort.

landing.heroSubtitle: Bulk update prices safely across your entire store — with preview, undo, and audit history built in.
landing.heroBullet1: Preview every change before it goes live
landing.heroBullet2: Undo any update in one click
landing.heroBullet4: Full audit history for every product
landing.protection1Body: Review every price change before it reaches your storefront.
landing.protection2Body: One click restores previous prices across affected products.
landing.protection3Body: Plan promotions ahead. Windows auto-restore when they end.
landing.protection4Body: Every rule change and pricing update is tracked per product.
landing.protection5Body: Pricing actions pause if your subscription becomes inactive.
landing.protection6Body: Uses the official Admin API. Nothing lives outside your store.

createRule.title: Step 1: Create your first pricing rule
createRule.doneBody: Your pricing rule is set up. You can adjust it any time from the Rules page.
createRule.body: A pricing rule tells Price Polish how to calculate your prices. Start with a percentage markup or markdown, then choose how prices should end.
createRule.tip: Begin with a small percentage adjustment. You can preview results before applying anything to your store.

preview.title: Step 2: Preview your pricing
preview.doneBody: You've seen how your pricing rule applies to your products. Ready to apply it?
preview.body: Preview shows you exactly what prices will change to before you apply anything. Review the list and confirm the changes look right.

apply.title: Step 3: Apply your first pricing update
apply.doneBody: Your pricing update was applied. The history is recorded and can be reverted at any time.
apply.body: Apply your pricing to your store catalog. Every change is tracked and can be reverted, so you can move forward confidently.

success.title: Setup complete
success.body:
Your pricing update was applied successfully.

You're ready to run future pricing updates with confidence. Review your campaign history, schedule promotions, or adjust your pricing rules at any time.

banner.intro: Preview upcoming prices, apply catalog updates instantly, schedule future campaigns, or enable dynamic live storefront pricing.
banner.refreshTip: Refresh previews after updating pricing rules so the dashboard reflects your latest calculations.
banner.livePricingTip: If you want your applied catalog value to remain the final customer-facing price, keep Live Pricing disabled or reduce Live Pricing rules to 0%.

desc.recommendedWorkflow: A safe and predictable workflow for managing pricing updates.
desc.currentVsTextbox: These values work together to help you review pricing changes clearly.
desc.applyUpdates: Apply updates Shopify immediately across your catalog.
desc.livePricing: Dynamically adjusts storefront display prices without modifying catalog values.
desc.manualOverrides: Manual input is designed for one-time pricing overrides.
desc.scheduling: Create automated pricing campaigns that run later without manual intervention.
desc.safetyRecovery: All pricing actions are designed to be reviewable and recoverable.
desc.pricingRulesBasics: Preview prices are calculated from your current live product prices.

workflow.step1_desc: Set markup, rounding, and charm pricing in Pricing Rules.
workflow.step2_desc: Load the latest calculated prices on the Dashboard.
workflow.step3_desc: Compare Current vs Textbox before applying updates.
workflow.step4_label: Apply now or Schedule for later:
workflow.step4_desc: Apply updates Shopify immediately or schedule automated campaigns.
workflow.step5_desc: Restore previous prices after bulk updates.

currentVsTextbox.textbox_desc: Your next calculated preview price based on pricing rules or manual input.

applyUpdates.all_desc: updates every item in the preview list.
applyUpdates.collection_desc: applies updates to a selected collection.

livePricing.point1: Live Pricing affects storefront display only.
livePricing.point3: Live Pricing rules may layer on top of applied catalog prices.

manualOverrides.point1: Typing a custom value temporarily overrides the calculated preview for that product.
manualOverrides.point2: When applied, Shopify receives your exact manual value without additional pricing adjustments.
manualOverrides.point3: After apply, pricing rules resume using the newly updated product price as the baseline.
manualOverrides.point4: Use Reset to restore pricing-rule control before applying.

scheduling.point1: Scheduling automatically stages and publishes pricing updates.
scheduling.point2: You no longer need to Apply before scheduling.
scheduling.point3: Schedule History tracks campaigns and included products.
scheduling.point4: Ideal for promotions, launch events, and timed campaigns.

safety.step2_desc: Restore previous prices after bulk updates.
safety.step3_desc: Original prices are stored securely for rollback and audit purposes.
